rulesPanel.title: Categorization rules

When that merchant appears in a future import or captured transaction, Sprout reuses the saved category. Manually added transactions are not changed automatically.

importer.title: Import / export
importer.dropTitle: Upload a CSV and preview transactions before importing
importer.dropBody: Sprout auto-detects Monarch, YNAB, Goodbudget, and Mint exports, and lets you map any other bank CSV without leaving the page.
importer.hintMonarchBody: Monarch, YNAB, Goodbudget, and Mint are recognized automatically.
importer.hintPreviewBody: Check merchants, dates, and signed amounts before import.

importer.capBankBody: Use a built-in preset, or map any bank’s CSV columns yourself.

importer.capAmountsBody: Signed, debit/credit, and inflow/outflow formats are all supported.
importer.capDupBody: Re-import the same file anytime without creating duplicate rows.
importer.mappingTitle: Review how this file should import

importer.previewEmptyBody: Pick the right columns and Sprout will show sample rows before you import them.

importer.supPreviewBody: Check a few rows first so dates, merchants, and amounts look right.
importer.supAnyBody: Use a built-in preset (Monarch, YNAB, Goodbudget, Mint) or map your bank’s columns yourself.
importer.supDupBody: Already-imported rows are skipped when you re-import a statement.
importer.smartBodyMobile: AI categorization, flexible amount columns, and duplicate protection are all built in.
importer.mappingSubtitleMobile: Confirm how this statement should import.
importer.behaviorBody: Sprout skips duplicates, excludes internal moves, and keeps uncategorized rows visible so you can clean them up later.
importer.exportBody: Export a clean CSV with date, merchant, category, and signed amount columns so you can archive it or move it into another tool.

groups.bulkSelected: {count, plural, one {# record selected} other {# records selected}}

groups.bulkDeletePermission: Only the author or group owner can delete a record.

groups.bulkEditHint: Saved shares stay unchanged. Update an expense and all linked refunds together when changing category. A refund cannot precede its original expense.

groups.treeReviewHint: Review every change below. Nothing has been saved yet. Confirm once more to apply this draft.
groups.treeConflict: Categories or group data changed. Reload categories and review a fresh draft before saving.
groups.treeRoots: Top-level categories · drop here to promote
groups.treeDropChild: Drop here to make a subcategory of {name}
groups.treeTapHint: On touch or keyboard, select a handle and then choose a destination box.

groups.ratioSaveHint: Saved percentages are used for the next calculation. Existing split results stay unchanged.
groups.splitCalculateHint: Choose periods and records, then calculate. Repeating a split replaces those records’ results and keeps original records and payments unchanged.
groups.splitReviewHint: Review changed records before calculating. Keep previous result to dismiss this edit from future reminders. Linked expenses and refunds are selected together.
groups.splitLinkedHint: Linked expenses or refunds outside the selected dates are included in this review to keep allocations consistent.
groups.splitKeepPrevious: Keep previous result; do not remind again
groups.splitExcludedHint: This edit is excluded. You can explicitly include it again.
groups.splitNetPreview: Projected all-time settlement, including previous splits and actual payments
groups.splitReviewRequired: Choose whether to include or keep each changed record before continuing.
groups.includeNextSplit: Include this edit in the next split
